item.description:
This is the original music video synced to a custom edit of the "Fade" version.

The differences are subtle, though easy to spot: there is less reverb on her opening "Cherish, cherish" vocals, and the synth in the break sits louder than on the album version.

To get the "Fade" version to match the video's lip-sync and longer duration, I reconstructed it using elements from the Extended Version.
